# l402-llm-mcp

Pay-per-query LLM + data tools over Lightning (L402) and x402 (USDC). OpenAI-compatible chat + MCP endpoint.

## Endpoints (stable, Tailscale Funnel)

- L402 / MCP base: https://pyfile-agent.taile3ff35.ts.net:8443
  - POST /v1/chat/completions — chat completion (10 sats short / 50 sats long)
  - POST /mcp — streamable-HTTP MCP
- x402 (USDC on Base/Polygon/Arbitrum): https://pyfile-agent.taile3ff35.ts.net:10000
  - POST /v1/chat/completions ($0.005), GET /v1/brief ($0.03), GET /data/* ($0.01)
  - Discovery: https://pyfile-agent.taile3ff35.ts.net:10000/.well-known/x402
  - OpenAPI 3.1: https://pyfile-agent.taile3ff35.ts.net:10000/openapi.json
- Nano (XNO): https://pyfile-agent.taile3ff35.ts.net/v1/chat/completions (0.001 XNO)

## MCP tools (6)

- chat — LLM answer (Bearer key required)
- brief — composite analyst brief: live facts + LLM summary (Bearer key required)
- dns_lookup, crypto_price, base_gas, wikipedia_summary — free utility data tools

## Models

- gemini-3.6-flash
- gpt-oss-120b

## Discovery

- 402 Index: L402 LLM API + x402 (pyfile-toolkit), healthy
- Official MCP Registry: io.github.pyfile-toolkit/pyfile-llm
- Nostr kind-30015: pyfile-x402-data (28 endpoints)
- NanoBazaar: one LLM answer per prompt (0.001 XNO)
